title: A day at Green Park Zoo
instructions: Hayvanat bahçesinde bir anons. Saatleri ve yerleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Good morning and welcome to Green Park Zoo.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Today, the elephants eat at ten thirty, near the lake.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The new baby giraffe is in the African house. You can see her from twelve to two.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The penguin show is at three o'clock. It is free.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Please do not give food to the animals.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The zoo shop is next to the main gate, and the café is next to the monkeys.
